From caeb4b0a11b3393e43f7fa8e0a5a18462acc66bd Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kent Overstreet <kent.overstreet@linux.dev>
Date: Sun, 31 Mar 2024 17:52:12 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] aio: Fix null ptr deref in aio_complete() wakeup

list_del_init_careful() needs to be the last access to the wait queue
entry - it effectively unlocks access.

Previously, finish_wait() would see the empty list head and skip taking
the lock, and then we'd return - but the completion path would still
attempt to do the wakeup after the task_struct pointer had been
overwritten.

Fixes: 71eb6b6b0ba9 ("fs/aio: obey min_nr when doing wakeups")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/linux-fsdevel/CAHTA-ubfwwB51A5Wg5M6H_rPEQK9pNf8FkAGH=vr=FEkyRrtqw@mail.gmail.com/
Signed-off-by: Kent Overstreet <kent.overstreet@linux.dev>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/stable/20240331215212.522544-1-kent.overstreet%40linux.dev
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240331215212.522544-1-kent.overstreet@linux.dev
Signed-off-by: Christian Brauner <brauner@kernel.org>

diff --git a/fs/aio.c b/fs/aio.c
index 9cdaa2faa536..0f4f531c9780 100644
--- a/fs/aio.c
+++ b/fs/aio.c
@@ -1202,8 +1202,8 @@ static void aio_complete(struct aio_kiocb *iocb)
 		spin_lock_irqsave(&ctx->wait.lock, flags);
 		list_for_each_entry_safe(curr, next, &ctx->wait.head, w.entry)
 			if (avail >= curr->min_nr) {
-				list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);
 				wake_up_process(curr->w.private);
+				list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);
 			}
 		spin_unlock_irqrestore(&ctx->wait.lock, flags);
 	}
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `fs/aio.c`**
- In the `aio_complete` function, the order of operations has been modified. The call to `list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);` has been moved to occur after the `wake_up_process(curr->w.private);` call. This change ensures that the wait queue entry is only removed after the wake-up process is initiated.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The modification addresses a potential null pointer dereference issue that could occur if the wait queue entry is removed before the wake-up process is called. By ensuring that `list_del_init_careful()` is the last operation on the wait queue entry, the patch prevents the completion path from attempting to access an invalid `task_struct` pointer, thereby fixing the bug introduced in a previous commit (71eb6b6b0ba9). This change enhances the stability and correctness of the asynchronous I/O completion handling.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);
wake_up_process(curr->w.private);
```
Reason:
The premature removal of the wait queue entry (`list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);`) before calling `wake_up_process(curr->w.private);` causes the completion path to access a `task_struct` pointer that has already been overwritten, leading to a null pointer dereference.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
wake_up_process(curr->w.private);
list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);
```
Reason:
By moving the `list_del_init_careful(&curr->w.entry);` statement after the `wake_up_process(curr->w.private);` call, the code ensures that the wake-up process can safely access the `task_struct` pointer before it is removed from the wait queue, preventing the null pointer dereference.
